feature_contract.goal: Keep all classified native BA9D0 gameplay HUD text glyphs attached to their exact ScreenHud producer through synchronous draw and queued sprite paths, without a stale world/rank pending Draw hijacking their binocular ownership.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Exact BA9D0 classified HUD text producer only; do not change unknown callers, existing queued SpriteNode priority, +TIME, rank world markers, F11/ESC, SkyGlow, lens, FFB, DX11 or frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: BA9D0 original canonical caller identifies native gameplay HUD text and may rasterize synchronously before the clip/sprani SpriteNode queue exists.
OutRunHudTextProducer_dest sets exact ScreenHud and direct text producer while ScopedExactProducerSemantic owns and restores an earlier pending world/marker Draw token.
Already tagged queue children remain governed by SpriteNode ownership; R26+HUD selected native game DLL uses existing per-eye screen-HUD planes and projective shader/fixed-function branches.
subcomponents: ScreenHud-only direct BA9D0 source lifetime isolates NextDrawScope before original game rasterization and restores it afterward, excluding unclassified/world callers.

Preserve peripheral/non-peripheral gameplay HUD text producer token and existing child queue replay, then assert synchronous owner restoration and queue-priority using Windows host smoke plus negative mutation.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Live BA9D0 source used ScopedExactProducerSemantic(ScreenHud, nullptr, false, token) even though ConsumeForDraw prioritizes any previously armed NextDrawScope; earlier world marker or SceneEffect Draw can therefore replace the exact HUD text semantic.
source_trace: Canonical OutRunHudTextCallerRva and OutRunVRHudSemantics::ClassifyCaller determine the exact ScreenHud source; no change to unknown or world classification.
The original BA9D0 hook can draw before put_clip_sprite/sprani nodes and uses ScopedExactProducerSemantic; the previous isolatePendingDraw=false left an older pending world draw in NextDrawScope.

ConsumeForDraw takes NextDrawScope before EffectiveScope, so the pending world token could win; R26+HUD per-eye transform follows the incorrectly selected scope, while queued nodes retain their own authority.
diagnosis.root_cause: The exact BA9D0 synchronous ScreenHud producer did not opt into existing ScopedExactProducerSemantic pending-draw shielding; a preceding world/marker semantic token could be consumed by a valid game HUD glyph.
alternatives_rejected: Do not override all text or force global ScreenHud classification; unknown/GOAL and world producers have distinct owners.
Do not weaken SpriteNode queue precedence, flush all D3DX, remove world effects or alter SkyGlow and HUD layout sizing.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The native game BA9D0 direct text scope now opts into RAII pending-draw isolation, preserving original registered ScreenHud and both exact HUD text producer tokens; queued sprites still have priority and the original hook is called unchanged.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Changed-area producer verifier validates the exact classified glyph source and mutates pending isolation and token; host goal/HUD owner smoke covers ordinary and peripheral HUD texts with prior world Draw and restores saved token.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Existing compiled R26+HUD renderer constructs per-eye HUD planes from trusted source; this change only fixes original ScreenHud selection, not a user-observed Quest3 display result.

runtime_evidence: No actual original game or Quest3/VDXR test in this task; static code and CI cannot establish binocular optical PASS.
